dct_description_sm: Two aeromagnetic data sets, one collected by GSC and one collected for Pure Gold. Development of wavelet based noise suppression routine to minimise effect of strong magnetic signal associated with borehole well heads. Integration of data from two surveys reduction of data to a common terrain clearance
